#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll p[17];

ll solve(ll n, int len) {
    ll q = n / p[len];
    ll r = n % p[len];
    if (r == 0) return q * len;
    else return q * len + min(solve(r, len-1), len + solve(p[len] - r, len-1));
}

ll readll() {
    ll x = 0;
    int c = getchar();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') c = getchar();
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getchar();
    }
    return x;
}

void writell(ll x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        putchar('0');
        return;
    }
    char buf[20];
    int i = 0;
    while (x) {
        buf[i++] = '0' + (x % 10);
        x /= 10;
    }
    while (i--) putchar(buf[i]);
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) p[i] = p[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    ll n = readll();
    ll ans = solve(n, 16);
    writell(ans);
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}
